result.summary: The food delivery app page appears visually well-structured with no significant broken elements. All UI components render correctly.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card appears with a white background circle, while the heart icon on the pizza card below has a dark/transparent background, creating visual inconsistency in the favorite button styling across cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite (heart) icon background treatment across all restaurant cards for a consistent look.
